experiment_design.distortion: original BF16 -> F32 weight matrix, encode with original BEGLIN gguf_quantize_q4g64_error_feedback and gguf_quantize_qNg64 n=8; decode compressed codes and compute each tensor's quantization weight relative L2 error.
experiment_design.sensitivity_label: weight-only relative distortion PROXY; not model task sensitivity or activation Jacobian
experiment_design.role_budget: select exactly four out of 28 layers per each of seven roles for n8 promotion, 28/196 total
experiment_design.ranking: within each role rank by q4 normalized Frobenius squared relative error minus qNg64_n8 squared relative error (high first), then layer ascending for tie
experiment_design.control: four random layers without replacement from 28 within each role, RNG numpy PCG64 seed73; same role/shape costs
experiment_design.hold_fixed: Qwen tied lm_head/embed FP32, norms FP32, qkv biases F32, original BF16 checkpoint and tokenizer, 28 layers, prompt token files, runtime binary, CPU threads
experiment_design.policy_file_format: per role 0-based layer, input policy SHA-256 binding; no deployment
experiment_design.prompts: fixed public synthetic English strings in separate source file, no C1D or V6 data; two existing locked 10/13 token prompts first; 3-5 more public synthetic prompts before any candidate metrics if resource allows
metrics: real native 151936-way final logits per same prompt: top1 match, KL(f32||tier), L2
teacher forced NLL/PPL vs identical prompt windows
steady decode benchmark p50 3 repeats with warmup
logical per-role weight bytes and observed peak RSS if available

thresholds.Q_quality_gate: development only: mean NLL relative increase <= 0.02 AND classification AUROC drop <=0.03 must be evaluated separately; do not mark final PASS from PPL alone
thresholds.Q_speed_gate: do not claim throughput benefit without measured prefill/decode and cache admission

experiment_design.possible_outcomes: negative results preserved, do not tune proxy scoring on evaluated PPL windows
experiment_design.quant_code_guard: research-only copy, no changes to original qwen_infer.c, main, running processes, model checkpoints; n4 uses dedicated Q4G64 not qNg64
experiment_design.risk: CPU n8 bitplane GEMV is scalar and may run far slower; budget-bound durations are not deployment timing
experiment_design.prior_evidence: 03 precision first-token result: full n8 KL~0.00008, full q4 KL~0.245 on one prompt, insufficient for Q acceptance
